findings.issue: Media call room covers entire viewport on mobile with no minimize or picture-in-picture mode
findings.impact: Mobile users in a call cannot access chat, threads, or navigate the app without leaving the call entirely.
findings.fix: Implement a minimized floating PiP overlay for mobile when navigating away from the call view.

findings.issue: Tablet auto-collapse uses unthrottled window resize listener and snaps between collapsed/expanded with no animation
findings.impact: Rapid window resizing may cause performance jank; instantaneous snap at breakpoint boundaries feels unpolished.
findings.fix: Debounce resize handler with requestAnimationFrame; add CSS transition on sidebar width.

findings.issue: Thread panel has fixed width w-80 (320px) on desktop with no sizing variant for smaller viewports
findings.impact: On 1024px-wide screens with sidebar open, the thread panel consumes ~30% of remaining space, leaving a narrow chat column.
findings.fix: Use responsive width: w-72 at md, w-80 at lg, and allow user resizing with a drag handle.

findings.issue: Message list uses fixed padding (pb-14) for mobile bottom nav instead of responsive spacing aware of nav height
findings.impact: If mobile bottom nav height varies, messages at the bottom may be clipped or have excessive whitespace.
findings.fix: Replace pb-14 with env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + dynamic calculation based on actual nav element height.
